title: The partner hand-off
brief: A partner-controlled tool asks the agent to export data, and a helpful agent relays a sensitive value from this app across the boundary.
mitigation: Data from one origin or tool must not be handed to another origin's tool. Strip or withhold sensitive fields before any cross-boundary export.
